(Currently amended) Claim 281: A tool comprising a lamination of at least two layers and at least two adhesive layers, the tool comprising first and second layers and __a first adhesive layer__ configured to be cured on the first layer, __a second adhesive layer__ configured to be cured on the second layer, __wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are configured to be cured to each other__, the tool has a circular shape and includes a plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments having an inner arc shape and an outer arc shape, wherein the inner arc shape of each of the arc-shaped cutting segments is directly affixed to an outer perimeter of the first and second layers, a medial section, wherein __the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer__ are located on opposite sides of the medial section and the first layer and the second layer are aligned with __the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer__.
